parsed.note_claim: Under UNCLOS Article 110(1)(d), warships may board vessels suspected of being stateless on the high seas.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Article110 Right of visit 1. ... a warship which encounters on the high seas a foreign ship ... is not justified in boarding it unless there is reasonable ground for suspecting that: ... (d) the ship is without nationality
parsed.reason: The page contains the text of UNCLOS Article 110, which explicitly permits warships to board foreign ships on the high seas if there is reasonable ground to suspect the ship is without nationality.
